_readme.title: Vayu + VIB Integrator Roadmap
_readme.source: Current VIB Integrator roadmap supplied for website synchronization
_readme.status_policy: Statuses reflect the supplied roadmap. Do not mark implementation complete without repository and test evidence.

phase_status.next: Immediate next work, not yet marked complete.
phase_status.planned: Planned; not started or not verified.
phase_status.deferred: Intentionally deferred and gated; do not implement until its prerequisites/direction allow it.

_readme.notes: This website view tracks the supplied VIB Integrator roadmap. Phase 0.1 and Phase 1 work are next. The .vye work in Phase 2 is deferred. Implementation status must be updated only from verified source and test evidence.

phases.name: Baseline and subsystem ownership
phases.description: Establish a measured clean-build baseline and make ownership and route capabilities explicit before implementation expands.

subphases.name: Record the Visual Studio Community clean-build and clean-test baseline: Rebuild, Build, then run run_all.ps1; make no assumptions about prior build state.
subphases.description: Output: tests/vib_baseline.ps1 with preconditions documented in script comments. Do not add a Markdown file.

subphases.name: Codify subsystem ownership: identify which files belong to the frontend, typechecker, interpreter, VM, and VIB.
subphases.description: Output: vib::Integrator Feature enum covering the four execution routes and every language feature.

subphases.name: Encode the feature-by-route capability matrix in code as the single source of truth.
subphases.description: Output: static CapabilityInfo table inside VIB/Integrator.cpp.

subphases.name: Curate reference fixtures with stable expected stdout for --run and --vm, plus stable failure messages for --native, --native-out, --dump-ir, and --emit-runtime.
subphases.description: Output: fixture and expected-output list in tests/vib_baseline.ps1.

phases.name: Integrator capability API and CLI diagnostics
phases.description: Expose truthful, table-driven capability reporting through VIB and the existing compiler driver.

subphases.name: Expand VIB/Integrator.hpp and VIB/Integrator.cpp with Feature, SupportLevel, and CapabilityInfo; add capabilities(), capability(Feature), featureName(), and supportLevelName().
subphases.description: Output: capability query API; compile() and dumpIR() derive messages from the table.

subphases.name: Route NativeCompiler through vib::Integrator so no native-path message is hardcoded outside VIB.
subphases.description: Output: NativeCompiler::lastError() comes from Integrator; dumpIR prints the capability-derived message.

subphases.name: Add --vib-status to vayuc and route --native, --native-out, --dump-ir, and --emit-runtime errors through Integrator.
subphases.description: Output: new CLI flag; all four flags emit capability-derived diagnostics.

subphases.name: Build the Phase 0/1 harness for fixture equality, native-path rejection, --vib-status output shape, and checking that .md files are not modified.
subphases.description: Output: tests/vib_baseline.ps1.

phases.name: VYE container design and delivery
phases.description: Deferred by direction. Keep container work design-only until the language subset and Integrator are ready; do not implement a writer early.

subphases.name: Design-only .vye container specification: magic, version, section table, entry point, deterministic serialization, and compatibility policy.
subphases.description: Output: design represented in code comments/API shape only. No implementation and no writer.

subphases.name: Implement a deterministic .vye writer, gated by --emit-vye <path> that only becomes active after Phase 10.
subphases.description: Output: --emit-vye writes a package. Deferred until the gate is reached.

subphases.name: Implement a strict .vye reader, verifier, and vayu run <file>.vye execution verb.
subphases.description: Output: round-trip and malformed-input tests pass. Deferred until the package format is authorized for implementation.

phases.name: Basic arithmetic and values
phases.description: Define and implement the first small, precisely specified Integrator language subset.

subphases.name: Specify integer, boolean, and None semantics for the Integrator, including overflow, conversion, and division by zero.
subphases.description: Output: semantics contract in code comments and Feature::BasicArithmetic.

subphases.name: Lower integer and boolean expressions plus local variables into the first internal form.
subphases.description: Output: BasicArithmetic reports SupportLevel::Supported in --vib-status.

phases.name: String semantics and operations
phases.description: Establish deterministic string behavior before exposing string support.

subphases.name: Define UTF-8 policy, representation, equality, concatenation, length, and index-bound behavior.
subphases.description: Output: Feature::Strings semantics specified in code.

subphases.name: Lower string constants and string operations.
subphases.description: Output: Strings changes to Supported only after conformance tests pass.

phases.name: Functions and calls
phases.description: Implement function execution with explicit call and scope semantics.

subphases.name: Implement functions, parameters, return values, local scopes, direct calls, and arity/type checks.
subphases.description: Output: Feature::Functions reports Supported.

subphases.name: Add recursion only after stack-frame safety is demonstrated.
subphases.description: Output: recursion tests pass.

phases.name: Control flow and branch verification
phases.description: Add predictable control flow and reject malformed control-flow structures.

subphases.name: Implement conditional branches, loops, and return, break, and continue semantics.
subphases.description: Output: Feature::ControlFlow reports Supported.

subphases.name: Validate branch targets and diagnose unreachable code.
subphases.description: Output: invalid-branch tests are rejected.

phases.name: Collections
phases.description: Add collection types individually with explicit ownership and conformance requirements.

subphases.name: Implement the first collection type, list, with explicit ownership, indexing, mutation, and iteration.
subphases.description: Output: Feature::Collections reports partial support for list.

subphases.name: Implement map, tuple, and set as subsequent collection types, each gated by conformance tests.
subphases.description: Output: remaining collections report Supported only after their tests pass.

phases.name: Modules and multi-file builds
phases.description: Resolve module identity and dependencies reproducibly.

subphases.name: Implement module identity, import resolution, and dependency validation.
subphases.description: Output: Feature::Modules reports Supported.

subphases.name: Build multi-file programs reproducibly from declared inputs.
subphases.description: Output: multi-file fixture passes.

phases.name: Artifact reader verification and runtime compatibility
phases.description: Package-reader hardening is gated on the existence of the .vye format; runtime compatibility policy remains code-defined.

subphases.name: Fuzz and property-test the reader and verifier only after .vye exists (Phase 2 is deferred).
subphases.description: Output: malformed-input test suite. Do not start before the .vye gate is satisfied.

subphases.name: Define runtime compatibility policy and version semantics in code, without adding a .md file.
subphases.description: Output: --vib-status gains a runtime-version row.

phases.name: Advanced language features and system APIs
phases.description: Expand the supported subset in small, independently testable groups.

subphases.name: Implement exceptions, classes/objects, closures, higher-order functions, generators, and pointers one group at a time, with separate tests for each.
subphases.description: Output: each feature changes status independently in --vib-status.

subphases.name: Implement the system APIs and standard-library surface relevant to the Integrator subset.
subphases.description: Output: feature parity with the interpreter for the supported subset.

phases.name: Benchmarks and reusable compilation
phases.description: Measure real behavior before optimizing, then add a safe persistent artifact cache and incremental graph.

subphases.name: Measure compile time, startup, steady-state execution, memory, and package size as separate metrics.
subphases.description: Output: results column in VIB/docs/BENCHMARK_PREDICTIONS.md, maintained by GPT.

subphases.name: Implement a content-addressed, atomic, recoverable artifact cache and ensure incremental builds match clean-build output.
subphases.description: Output: cache and incremental-equivalence tests.

phases.name: Native code generation
phases.description: Research and implement native code generation only on top of the verified representation, with target rules owned by Vayu.

subphases.name: Research and implement native code generation on top of the verified representation; keep target and ABI rules in Vayu-owned code.
subphases.description: Output: native artifacts pass conformance tests for each supported target.

subphases.name: Do not bundle LLD, DLLs, import libraries, or an external backend.
subphases.description: Output: --vib-status reports NativeCodegen = Supported only for targets proven by tests.

phases.name: Vayu-owned ONNX support
phases.description: Build an independent ONNX reader and runtime subset without a Python-based generator.

subphases.name: Implement a Vayu-owned ONNX parser/reader and native test fixtures; do not use a Python generator.
subphases.description: Output: malformed-model and numerical-correctness tests.

subphases.name: Implement a small operator subset first and expand only through tests.
subphases.description: Output: --vib-status reports support per operator.

phases.name: Runtime capability reporting and self-hosting
phases.description: Expose machine-readable runtime capabilities and investigate bootstrap only after the Integrator subset stabilizes.

subphases.name: Publish the supported feature/runtime-version matrix at runtime using --vib-status --json.
subphases.description: Output: machine-readable capability matrix.

subphases.name: Start the self-hosting bootstrap loop only after the Integrator subset is stable.
subphases.description: Output: documented fixpoint reproduced by run_all.ps1 -FixpointOnly.
